description: libxslt cases whose expected output does not measure XSLT 1.0 conformance of this processor: implementation-defined values, libxslt/EXSLT extensions, DTD features the jsdom XML parser used by the runner does not support, cases the runner misclassifies, and documented deliberate deviations from libxslt. A listed case that passes still counts as a pass; a listed case that does not pass is reported as skip and left out of the pass rate.
